title: TensorPlate Python/PyTorch Sidecar IPC Header
description: Schema header for the message exchange between `tensorplate-serving` (C++) and the managed Python/PyTorch sidecar backend. Each IPC message on the Unix domain socket is `[length-prefixed JSON header][raw tensor payload bytes]`. Tensor payloads are NEVER JSON-encoded; this schema describes only the header.

message_id.description: Per-message identifier. Replies (response / event) carry the same `message_id` as the originating request.

correlation_id.description: Inference correlation id propagated from the originating InferRequest.

kind.description: Message kind. `*_response` messages carry the same `message_id` as the originating request; `*_event` messages are unsolicited and carry their own `message_id`.

deadline_ns.description: Monotonic absolute deadline in nanoseconds (sender-clock). The sidecar treats sender and receiver clocks as the same domain because both run on the local device.

payload_offset.description: Offset of this tensor's raw bytes inside the message's tensor-payload region (the region that follows the JSON header on the wire).

payload_length.description: Length of this tensor's raw bytes inside the tensor-payload region.

tensors.description: Per-message tensor manifest. The bytes themselves ride after the JSON header, packed at the offsets recorded here.
